purpose: Validate workflow completeness, selected production-mode outputs, PASS/FAIL aggregation, cross-file consistency, and readiness scope without duplicating detailed validation rules owned by stage-specific modules or agents.

talking_head.authority_reference: The authoritative production rules for this branch are defined in Production_TalkingHead_Agent.

documentary.authority_reference: The authoritative production rules for this branch are defined in Production_Agent.

production_readiness.description: Validate the project through the selected production-mode package only. Publishing-stage files are not required in this scope.

publishing_readiness.description: Validate all production-readiness requirements plus publishing, QA, and project-summary deliverables.

stage_authorities.authority_reference: The authoritative validation rules for this stage are defined in Agents/Outlier_Agent.md.

The authoritative validation rules for this stage are defined in SYS_06_THUMBNAIL_ENGINE.

workflow_sequencing.check: Stages must execute in DAG order, and the production-mode decision gate must run before production.

stage_dependencies.check: Each stage must receive the required upstream inputs declared by the workflow DAG and agent registry.

pass_fail_aggregation.check: Readiness is PASS only when all required stages for the selected validation scope return PASS and selected production-mode outputs exist.

checks: stage_reports_do_not_disagree_on selected topic, selected title, medical gate status, production mode, or production deliverables
